rows.Condition: Cash price confirmed by a seller reply, fees confirmed or excluded
Cash price stated in the listing text, unconfirmed by reply
Nothing said about price type, and no financing language anywhere
rows.Effect: Full price-band points, no bonus, no cap

rows.Condition: Financing language present — the figure *may* still be the cash price
rows.Effect: Full price-band points, no penalty, tier capped at "Worth a look" until a seller reply settles it

rows.Condition: The ad itself says the figure is a down payment ("$1,500 down", "not cash price", *"enganche"*)
rows.Effect: No price-band points — the number is not the car's price, so there is nothing to band — no penalty, capped at "Marginal". Band it normally once the seller gives the real cash figure

rows.Condition: Rebuilt that clears the §6 quality gate (light cosmetic, documented, no airbags, no structure, ~35–45%+ off clean comps)
Rebuilt that fails the §6 quality gate
Good for the exact model year/powertrain, no major unresolved pattern
Mixed, insufficient data, or powertrain unknown
Poor — documented pattern of expensive major failures
rows.Points: −2 (cap at Marginal unless credible records show the risk was addressed)

rows.Condition: Relevant maintenance/service records support long-term ownership

tiers.meaning: include in the data dump, don't lead with it
